messages:
jordan: Heads-up 1-kickoff for SDK semver bump (v3 -> v4) + marketplace package name change. We need partner validation plan and a soft-deprecation timeline. Short ask: agree on test matrix and communication bullets by EOD.

anya: high level ok. can we avoid breaking webhook payloads? thatreaks SIs more than header names.

leo: telemetry needs: package_mismatch, api_version_reject, webhook_fail_rate. add a tag partner=acme for visibility.

sam: marketplace ops: we'll gate package rename behind feature-flag and mirror both packages for 4 weeks. need partner consent for dual-package testing.

maria: comms: propose two messages 1) technical notice for SI/devs, 2) customer-facing note. both to mention 30-day dual-package overlap and migration docs.

nate: runtime: plan to ship adapter that accepts old imports and proxies to v4. adapter will emit a deprecation header: `X-RW-SDK-Deprecation: v3` and metric `adapter_mapped`. rollback easy by enabling v3 routing.

acme_partner_rep: Acme: SI teams want a dry-run with their top 3 customers. also request a checklist: tests to run, failure indicators, contact for on-call. we'll provide windows next message.

legal-bot: Reminder: any public comms mentioning dates must be cleared by legal 48h before send.

ops-bot: FYI scheduled maintenance window available Tue 02:00-04:00 PT if needed.

jordan: Draft checklist (please edit):

- build adapter + publish to internal npm as `rw-sdk-adapter-v4-canary`
- run marketplace mirror for package `@rw/sdk` and `@rw/sdk-v4`
- execute partner dry-run with Acme customers (smoke + webhook replay)
- monitor metrics: api_version_reject, webhook_fail_rate, adapter_mapped
- auto-rollback if webhook_fail_rate > 1% for 5m
- publish migration guide + FAQ

leo: added alert rule: if api_version_reject > 0.2% for 3m then page eng-oncall and post in thread.

sam: I'll own the mirror and can run canary publishing on Mon 09:00 PT. will coordinate with @acme_partner_rep for dry-run times.

acme_partner_rep: We can take Mon 10:00-11:30 PT slot for customer dry-run. SI will bring a replay tool.

maria: I'll make two drafts and share by EOD: technical + customer. keep tone "smooth migration" and highlight 30-day overlap.

nate: ops note: adapter logs at debug during dry-run; change to info if we hit >0.5% errors.

jordan: OK actions: Sam publish canary Mon 09:00, Acme dry-run Mon 10:00-11:30, Leo finalizes alerts, Maria drafts comms, Legal review 48h before send. Thanks. :rocket:
